notes.title: Bonus Game (Can you Find 3D ESDA Cat)
notes.content:
Hi, we have added a bonus game where you can try to find a 3D ESDA Cat!!
Select the bonus option in the main menu to get a virtual tour of ESDA School in Jakarta, Indonesia.

Hint: You must use ultra setting and minimum nvidia 3000 series graphic card or radeon 6000 series

[b]Happy Playing!![/b]
